title: Botanical album ground perspective
reference_style: First-person sneaker photograph with a floating green album card integrated into dense foliage.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Immersive first-person music-poster photograph blending an everyday streetwear view with a floating album-cover interface.

subject.visible_body: Lower torso, loose olive-green track pants and both feet in classic dark canvas sneakers with white toe caps and laces
subject.pose: Feet positioned naturally near the bottom center, standing on a concrete walkway

environment.ground: Dense rich-green hedge or low garden foliage filling the upper frame
environment.foreground: Concrete paving slab at bottom edge
environment.foliage_detail: Small yellow flowers and scattered fallen leaves

graphic_elements.main_card: Large dark sage-green rounded rectangular music card placed on foliage just ahead of shoes
graphic_elements.album_art: Small square botanical tree illustration on left side of card
graphic_elements.text: Small label 'Single' above large lowercase title 'her', with tiny artist and release metadata below
graphic_elements.secondary_cards: Two oversized cropped and softly blurred duplicate cards entering from upper-left and upper-right edges

composition.depth: Shoes sharp, central album card readable, edge cards intentionally defocused
composition.palette: Deep botanical greens, olive fabric, concrete grey and off-white shoe details

post_processing.finish: Rich foliage texture, subtle grain, realistic perspective and selective blur

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No extra legs, malformed shoes, floating feet, misspelled title, warped card geometry, watermark, excessive saturation.
